about.summary: Full Stack Developer graduated from ESCOM-IPN with experience leading end-to-end architecture projects, from requirement analysis to deployment. Specialized in turning complex logic into functional solutions with React, Node.js, and relational databases. I stand out for fast technical adaptability, clean code, and strong ownership of software lifecycle with a focus on user experience and scalability.
description: I am an engineer characterized by consistent discipline and rigorous organization in every project I lead. From my technical studies at CECyT 8 to graduating from ESCOM with honors, I have maintained full commitment to academic and professional excellence.

I have strong self-learning and technical adaptability. My methodology is based on deep analysis of official documentation for libraries and frameworks, allowing me to master new technologies and deliver high-quality results quickly.

I naturally take leadership roles in development teams and lead by example. I am usually the first to tackle complex technical tasks so the team can achieve objectives with scalable architecture and clean code.
philosophy: Structured problem solving for complex systems.

cards.title: MusedMX
cards.role: Project Lead / Lead Full Stack Developer
cards.description: Web platform focused on improving cultural exploration in downtown Mexico City through personalized recommendations based on user preferences, interests, location radius, and visit history.
highlights: Museum recommendation system based on user preferences, location, and visit history.
Interactive UI built with React and SASS.
Google Maps API integration for museum location and navigation.
Ratings and comments system to improve future recommendations.
achievements: Final score 10/10 with honors for the graduation project at ESCOM-IPN.
Project presented at the CAECH 2025 International Congress.

cards.title: E-R Diagram Editor
cards.description: Entity-Relationship diagram design system with validation, relational diagram generation, SQL export, and Gemini-based AI assistant for technical guidance.
highlights: ER diagram validation with referential integrity rules.
Gemini assistant integration for creation support and technical questions.

cards.title: GeoWess
cards.role: Project Lead / Lead Full Stack Developer
cards.description: Comprehensive system for managing and tracking public construction projects in Mexico City, centralizing administrative, financial, and operational control.
achievements: Designed and implemented new architecture with React + TypeScript.
Refactoring focused on scalability and maintainability.
